product_metadata.title: softan Fleece Twin Sheets Set 3-Piece Fuzzy Bed Sets with 16" Deep Pocket Fitted Sheet, Flat Sheet and Pillowcase，Black
features: 3 PIECE TWIN SHEETS SET: 1 flat sheet 66*96 inches, 1 fitted sheet 39*75 inches, 1 pillowcases 20*30 inches; fade, stain and shrink resistant

DEEP POCKET FITTED SHEET: the fitted sheet with 360 around elastic strap will fit on thick mattresses up to 16 inches or a mattress with a topper with ease. No more fussing with remaking the bed - this sheet will stay put and fit perfectly on your mattress
HIGH QUALITY FLEECE: Our premium fleece bed sheets use 190 GSM for more warmth and better quality, a great alternative to flannel and features a charming color in soft to create an enjoyable look.

EXTRA SOFT & COMFORT SHEETS: 100% Micro Fleece sheet keeps you cozy warm even on the coldest of winter nights but also breathable enough to be used during the warm summer months; Soft, lightweight and breathable
EASY CARE EASY WASH: Machine wash before first use. Wash in cold water with similar colors. Tumble dry with low temperature. Do not iron. Do not bleach
